name: fanout-cre
description: Chainlink CRE workflows for Fanout and the scripts that sign schedules and run local simulations

scripts.setup: bun install && bun install --cwd refund-expired && bun install --cwd scheduled-payouts
scripts.test: cd refund-expired && bun test && cd ../scheduled-payouts && bun test
scripts.typecheck: cd refund-expired && bunx tsc --noEmit -p . && cd ../scheduled-payouts && bunx tsc --noEmit -p .
